title: Global Anthem Atlas: themes, Energy and Wisdom indices for the lyrics of national anthems and national songs (v1.0.0)
description:
Lyrics-based theme profiles for 242 national anthems and national songs (254 songs listed across 219 countries and regions). Each song has 12 theme scores (English lexicon, sentence-embedding anchors, zero-shot NLI and, for 159 songs, original-language roots), two descriptive indices with 90% uncertainty intervals (Energy = Mobilisation + Awakening; Wisdom = justice/peace, truth/virtue, future), five soft archetypes, per-country spectra with a data-confidence grade, curated etymology for 295 + 59 key terms, blind hand labels, and the complete reproducible pipeline.

Energy and Wisdom describe what the words of a song talk about, not countries or peoples; no ranking of nations is supported. Single-song levels carry about one level of uncertainty, mostly from translation.

Texts. Lyrics and translations are included only where rights allow (78 songs in full, 23 original-language only). For all other songs the package ships hashes and pinned source revisions; code/rehydrate.py re-fetches the texts from Wikipedia and other public sources and verifies them. A per-song rights audit is included.

Licences. Data, results, figures and documentation: CC BY-SA 4.0 (includes CC BY-SA text adapted from English Wikipedia; see NOTICE.md). Code (code/): MIT.

AI use. The pipeline, analyses, rights audit and documentation were built with AI agents under the direction of the author, atlas-awareness, who is responsible for the content.
notes: Wikipedia sources are pinned to revisions current at 2026-10-03 02:30 UTC (data/source_revisions.csv). Native-speaker review of the etymology layer is pending; corrections will be released as new versions.
references: Gebru, T., et al. (2021). Datasheets for Datasets. Communications of the ACM 64(12), 86-92. https://doi.org/10.1145/3458723
